note: Per-facing check tolerances of the structure tier (consult C2 C4, build B3). Grader side. Every entry names the rule it comes from: R2 = docs/spikes/rook-turnaround/research/R2-turnaround-craft.md (T1 to T20), PA-xx = the pixel-artist-characters pack. No number here comes from a reference picture (the Sprite Fusion 8-direction references). The rows of the given are read from the given frame at run time, not stored here. A test (tests/art-v2-grade.test.ts) checks that every entry has a rule and that nothing in the folder names a reference.

rowTol.rule: PA-22 (each landmark within 1 pixel of the same row in every facing); R2 T2 (rows equal at standing)

guideRows.rule: PA-22 guide rows: head top, eye, shoulder, belt (hip), feet. The eye row runs where eyes show (R2 section 2: front and 3/4 front).

s.rule: PA-19 (eyes 1 to 2 px); R2 T5 (both eyes on one row)

se.rule: R2 T5, T7 (3/4 front: far eye narrower or partly hidden); PA-19

n.rule: PA-19 (the back view shows no face); R2 T8 (back: no eye pixels)

ne.rule: PA-19; R2 T8 (3/4 back: no eye pixels)

nw.rule: R2 T8 (3/4 back: no eye pixels)

hands.maxNote: PA-20 says a hand is a 2 to 3 px cluster. The given's own hands measure 5 to 9 px of skin, so the 3 px upper bound cannot gate this character. It is a report line (ST-HANDS-MAX); the lower bound and the count gate.

farHandMin.rule: R2 section 2 (side and 3/4 back: one arm fully visible, the far hand partly hidden)

hands.rule: PA-20 (each hand is a distinct cluster); R2 section 2 (hands per facing)

item.rule: PA-20 (the carried item has its own outline); R2 T9 and PA-03 (outline near-black on at least 93 percent of edge cells)

litSide.rule: R2 T10 (one light, the same sign in all facings); PA-23. Legs are a report line: the walk frames change the sign of the legs with the pose, so it cannot gate. A part with less than minAbsAtSe luma between its halves at se has no clear lit side and is not checked.

rowTol.rule: R2 T2 (head top, first skin row, leg split row and foot row equal); PA-22 (within 1 pixel). The battle idle bounces, so the tolerance is added to its min and max rows.

sideGuide.note: e and w are compared with the battle idle, not with the given, and never by row widths: the idle's blade stance makes the widths useless (consult C2 C4).
